stories.title: Monzo named The Marketing Society Brand of the Year 2026 - Campaign UK
Geico unites brand icons in holiday ad mixing human craft, nostalgia
stories.summary: Geico is launching its first holiday campaign featuring multiple brand icons. The firm says the effort aligns with a trend of marketers prioritizing handcrafted creative amid AI fatigue. The insurance company has decided that the best way to combat automated content is to feature its own talking animals.

stories.title: Coca-Cola considers revival of Gold Spot drink
stories.summary: Coca-Cola is reportedly planning to revive its orange-flavoured soft drink Gold Spot in a low-sugar version, 26 years after it was discontinued. The move aims to combine nostalgia-led marketing with modern preferences for reduced-sugar beverages. The original brand was once known for its zing.

stories.title: Hershey releases branded film in theaters
stories.summary: Hershey has released a film in theaters this Wednesday. CEO Kirk Tanner said on a recent earnings call that the project has earned strong customer and retail support. The company describes the 90-minute production as being more than just an advertisement.

stories.title: Sebamed Launches ‘No-Drama Skincare’ Campaign with New Face and Body Care DVCs - Indian Startup Times
Tata Capital features Shubman Gill in loan awareness campaign
stories.summary: Tata Capital has launched a loan awareness campaign featuring cricketer Shubman Gill as an inspector. The company says the films encourage consumers to understand loan terms and repayment obligations before committing to credit. The campaign aims to help people make informed borrowing decisions through everyday financial milestones.

stories.title: Generali Central Life Insurance launches digital dream wall
stories.summary: Generali Central Life Insurance has expanded its national brand campaign with an interactive digital platform. The company invites users to write down their dreams and pledge a step toward achieving them. The initiative aims to turn aspirations into visible commitments and bring the company philosophy to life.

stories.title: L’Oreal India appoints Omnicom Media for influencer strategy
stories.summary: L’Oreal India has appointed Omnicom Media to lead its influencer marketing strategy across brands including Maybelline and CeraVe. The agency will oversee end-to-end activation and creator advocacy. The company says it is building connected approaches to reflect different audiences and cultural contexts.

stories.title: D2C industry growth fuels agency competition
stories.summary: India’s direct-to-consumer industry has evolved into a competitive ecosystem. Brands are increasingly choosing digital-first strategies to establish identities and build revenue. The growing popularity of social commerce and influencer-led promotions has created significant opportunities for agencies specializing in the sector.

stories.title: WPP Media expands Thailand leadership
stories.summary: WPP Media has appointed Shankar Rajagopal as CEO for its Thailand business, adding to his existing role in Vietnam. His mandate includes integrating artificial intelligence into media planning and buying. The agency also plans to introduce its Open Intelligence AI marketing model to the region.

stories.title: Ogilvy wins Veet’s global creative mandate, ending Havas’ long-standing partnership - IMPACT Magazine
BBDO Group India appoints Ashish Chakravarty as CCO
stories.summary: BBDO Group India has appointed Ashish Chakravarty as chief creative officer. Chakravarty joins from Garage Worldwide and will work alongside chairman Josy Paul. The agency says the appointment is intended to strengthen its creative output and develop talent within the organization.

stories.title: BBDO Group India appoints Ashish Chakravarty as CCO
stories.summary: BBDO Group India has appointed Ashish Chakravarty as chief creative officer. He joins from Garage Worldwide to work with chairman Josy Paul. The agency states the move is intended to strengthen its creative output and build its creative organization.

stories.title: Creative agencies adapt to changing market demands
stories.summary: India’s creative advertising industry has evolved into a space where technology and consumer insights converge to influence purchasing decisions. Agencies are positioning themselves as essential partners for organizations seeking to maintain relevance. The sector continues to blend traditional television campaigns with immersive digital experiences and influencer collaborations.

stories.title: The Brand Nostalgia Playbook: Why Indian Brands Are Revisiting Their Old Campaigns, Characters and Jingles - Agency Repo
Nexxen and Gracenote partner for CTV targeting
stories.summary: Advertising platform Nexxen has partnered with Gracenote to expand content-based targeting for connected TV. The integration allows advertisers to use program-level insights rather than relying on broader audience data. The company says this gives brands more granular control over the environments in which their ads appear.

stories.title: Max Balegde: how influencer turned a cunning comms plan into a No 10 nightmare - The Guardian
The Debate - Campaign rules for influencers? French regulator targets content creators - France 24
Max Balegde apologises for Downing Street video
stories.summary: Social media influencer Max Balegde has apologised after filming a video at Downing Street while miming a song containing lewd lyrics. The creator, invited to the site by Andy Burnham, blamed right-wing commentators for the resulting controversy. The prime minister's spokesperson called the post clearly not acceptable.

stories.title: Shah Rukh Khan sends legal notice over influencer reel
stories.summary: Actor Shah Rukh Khan has sent a legal notice to a social media influencer regarding an Instagram reel. The video featured footage of the actor and businessman Anant Ambani interacting with Sadhguru, which the actor's legal team says contained misleading and defamatory claims about the conversation.

stories.title: Fitness Influencer Loses 14 Kg By Walking 20,000 Steps Daily Inside Her 2BHK Flat - NDTV
Influencer Clavicular charged with rape
stories.summary: Social media influencer Braden E. Peters, known online as Clavicular, has been charged with rape and providing liquor to a minor. The charges follow an investigation by Chatham police into an incident in 2025. The influencer is associated with the online looksmaxxing fad.

stories.title: Max Balegde addresses Downing Street video controversy
stories.summary: Influencer Max Balegde has apologised for filming a lewd video at Downing Street. The creator, invited to the site to engage with online celebrities, said he had ten seconds to film before leaving. The prime minister's spokesperson confirmed the post was taken down for being unacceptable.

stories.title: Influencer row as PM’s team accused of turning No 10 into a ‘joke’ | The Independent - newspaper - Magzter
Influencer marketing shifts toward performance advertising
stories.summary: The influencer marketing industry is increasingly treating creator-led content as advertising assets for paid media campaigns. Brands are moving away from traditional collaborations, seeking to test and modify content to blur the lines between influencer partnerships and performance advertising. The playbook is changing to suit brand expectations.

stories.title: Meta reports $64.6 billion revenue as ad enforcement expands
stories.summary: Meta reported $64.601 billion in third-quarter revenue, a 26 percent increase year on year. The company's creator advertising business relies on automated moderation, which can interrupt delivery if permissions are mistaken. Operating margins were 35.4 percent, excluding a $9.89 billion legal charge.

stories.title: YouTube expands custom thumbnails to all Shorts creators
stories.summary: YouTube is allowing all creators to use custom thumbnails for Shorts, removing the previous requirement to be in the YouTube Partner Program. The platform says this update reflects a change in how it treats short-form video as part of a creator's broader media identity.

stories.title: Pinterest integrates with Microsoft Advertising
stories.summary: Pinterest has opened its advertising inventory to Microsoft Advertising, allowing brands to extend campaigns across the visual discovery platform. The integration enables access to home feed and search results without requiring new buying tools. The rollout covers North America, Australia and New Zealand.

stories.title: Meta expands Muse AI to Instagram shopping
stories.summary: Meta is integrating its Muse artificial intelligence assistant into Instagram to assist with product discovery and shopping. Announced on November 24, 2026, the tool allows users to share posts in private messages to receive automated recommendations. The company aims to simplify how users organise saved content.

stories.title: Meta and Amazon discuss AI shopping agent
stories.summary: Meta and Amazon are negotiating a potential agreement to restore access to Amazon's store for Meta's Muse AI agent. The companies are discussing how the tool displays search results and handles advertising. The talks follow a blockade imposed by Amazon in September.

stories.title: TikTok bans devices after Maldita finds child abuse posts with 48m views - PPC Land
Meta leverages Instagram saves to boost Muse AI
stories.summary: Meta is prompting Instagram users to organise saved posts within its Muse AI agent. About 20 percent of daily users save at least one post, many of which are ads or shoppable items. The company is using the feature to drive engagement for its personal AI.

stories.title: Meta reports 26 percent increase in ad revenue
stories.summary: Meta reported $63.1 billion in advertising revenue for the third quarter of 2026, up 26 percent year over year. The company cited strong demand, AI-powered tools and a 14 percent rise in the average price per ad. Total ad impressions increased 10 percent during the period.

stories.title: Ad tech sector faces consolidation pressure
stories.summary: AppLovin is reportedly in acquisition discussions with Criteo, adding to pressure on independent ad tech firms. Meta is also exploring connected TV advertising, further shifting the landscape. Some companies have reported challenging circumstances in recent earnings calls as the market for independent ad tech tightens.

stories.title: Transcosmos launches trans-AI Voice for customer data
stories.summary: Transcosmos has launched trans-AI Voice, a service designed to turn customer feedback from stores and contact centers into corporate assets. The platform combines voice collection with AI-powered insight extraction and dashboard visualization. It aims to help companies leverage offline data that was previously difficult to collect and analyze.

stories.title: BAM Analytix introduces Brand Relevance Score
stories.summary: BAM Analytix has released a 0 to 100 index called BRS to measure brand strength against competitors. The tool combines historical brand data with current consumer response to unify marketing performance and brand building. It attempts to resolve the long-standing divide in how marketing success is assessed.

stories.title: Target launches Ask Target AI assistant
stories.summary: Target has released a beta version of its AI assistant, Ask Target, within its app and website. The tool currently handles product discovery, inventory checks, and comparisons. While the retailer notes that early testing drove higher purchase rates, the assistant cannot yet complete transactions on behalf of shoppers.

stories.title: Automation Anywhere acquires Boost.ai
stories.summary: Automation Anywhere has acquired Boost.ai to expand its capabilities in conversational and voice AI for regulated industries. Boost.ai supports over 36 languages and claims a 90 percent resolution rate in production. The move is intended to integrate enterprise-grade agentic automation with existing customer service operations.

stories.title: Sellforte launches MCP for ad optimization
stories.summary: Sellforte has released Sellforte MCP, a measurement layer designed to connect retail data to AI marketing agents. The tool provides incremental and marginal return on ad spend data to help AI assistants optimize campaigns. It aims to provide the measurement infrastructure that automated agents currently lack.

stories.title: Agentic traffic expected to surge for Cyber Week
stories.summary: Cybersecurity firm Human Security expects agentic traffic to increase 150 times over last year during Cyber Week. Meta's Muse is responsible for nearly 70 percent of this volume. While agents are primarily browsing, checkout activity is rising despite some retailers continuing to block automated traffic.

stories.title: AI marketing tools see widespread adoption in India
stories.summary: The Indian digital marketing landscape has integrated AI across the marketing funnel by mid-2026. Businesses in major hubs like Bengaluru and Mumbai are using these tools for content generation, predictive analytics, and campaign optimization. The adoption marks a shift in sophistication compared to the industry two years prior.

stories.title: OpenClips automates video ad production
stories.summary: OpenClips.AI has launched a tool that generates video ads from product links or photos. The platform provides pre-made templates for various industries, allowing users to bypass manual filming or editing. It claims to deliver launch-ready ads while showing the price of creative assets before production begins.

stories.title: Salesforce survey highlights agentic commerce hurdles
stories.summary: A Salesforce study of holiday shoppers found that 22 percent of users experienced blocked agent purchases, while 27 percent reported overpriced items. Despite the growth of AI assistants, 73 percent of consumers remain uncomfortable sharing payment information with them. Merchants are advised to audit how their brands are recommended.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Online fraud is traditionally limited by the cost of the human labor needed to talk to potential victims. We ask whether hosted large language models will now supply that labor. We prompted ten off-the-shelf models to. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Can LLM-Simulated Respondents Pre-Test Survey Questions? Evidence From Preregistered Prospective Validation
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be conditioned to simulate behavioral responses, including survey responses, but it remains unclear whether and how these simulations can support downstream research tasks. Here, we evaluate whether simulated respondents can support. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Copy, Predict, Code the Rest: Lossless Graph Compression with Decoder-Side Neighbor Prediction
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a lossless compressor for directed graphs. It copies neighbors from an earlier row, predicts further targets from the part of the graph already decoded, and codes what remains. Its main coder, the candidate-bit coder. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Cross-Order Information-Guided Estimation for Non-Uniform Hypergraphs
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many real-world interactions involve groups of nodes rather than pairs. A non-uniform hypergraph records such interactions as hyperedges of different orders, where the order counts the nodes in a hyperedge. Full estimation evaluates every candidate hyperedge. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Graph neural networks and the energetic cavity method for combinatorial optimization
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the use of graph neural networks (GNNs) for finding approximate ground states of Ising models. Efficiently finding these ground states is of broad significance because many combinatorial optimization problems can be formulated as an. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Principled Detection of Coordinated Manipulation from Aggregate Distortion and Account Reuse
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Coordinated manipulation is collective: plausible accounts can jointly distort ratings, rankings, and engagement. Existing defenses primarily construct evidence from identities, graphs, content, or co-activity. We introduce an aggregate-first evidence layer that treats distortion of a context-level. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Quantum Community Detection for Data Analysis
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Community detection offers an alternative to conventional methods for data analysis tasks such as feature selection and clustering, and detecting communities with quantum algorithms is a promising avenue for quantum speedup. We investigate quantum spectral community. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
